channel.title: News Flash • Milton, MA
channel.description: Town of Milton news and announcements

item.title: Blue Hill Avenue water main work — road closure August 24-28
item.description: The Department of Public Works will close Blue Hill Avenue between Canton Avenue and Reedsdale Road for water main replacement. A detour will be posted.

item.title: Fall Town Meeting warrant opens for articles
item.description: The warrant for Fall Town Meeting is open. Citizen petition articles must be filed with the Town Clerk by September 11, 2026.

item.title: Town receives state grant for library roof replacement
item.description: Milton has been awarded a grant of $412,000 toward replacement of the Milton Public Library roof.

item.title: Voter registration deadline ahead of the September election
item.description: The last day to register to vote in the September 15 state primary is September 5. The Town Clerk's office will hold extended hours.
